members.name: Darin Smith
members.title: Executive Director, D11 Innovation Collective
members.bio: Nathan leads CSST's vision of reimagining high school as a professional environment where students grow into capable, self-directed adults. His background spans education leadership and innovation-focused learning design. Nathan built CSST from the ground up inside the Catalyst Campus ecosystem, creating a school culture where ambition is the norm.

members.name: Darin Smith
members.title: Principal
members.bio: Darin has spent 30 years in education as a chemistry teacher, principal, and district leader, and he now serves as principal of the Colorado Springs School of Technology. He wants CSST to be a school where students build strong foundations in reading, writing, math, communication, and critical thinking through work that is meaningful to them. He believes in helping students discover their strengths, collaborate with others, and solve real-world problems with confidence and purpose.

members.name: Matt Stewart
members.title: Dean of Students
members.bio: Matt is Dean of Students at CSST. He previously taught social studies here, framing history and civics through entrepreneurship and societal change. He now leads student culture and support, challenging students to think critically and take ownership of their path.

members.name: Milithza McNeil
members.title: School Counselor
members.bio: Milithza guides students through academic planning, career exploration, and personal development — helping them connect their interests to real pathways into tech, business, or beyond. She is a champion for every student's unique journey.

members.name: Hannah Wirtjes
members.title: Academic Support Specialist
members.bio: Hannah provides individualized academic support that meets students where they are and helps them reach where they want to go. Her work ensures no student falls through the cracks, whether they're pushing ahead or finding their footing.

members.name: Andrea Mullins
members.title: Admin Assistant & Bookkeeper
members.bio: Andrea manages the financial operations and day-to-day administrative needs of the school. Her work keeps the school's resources aligned with its mission and ensures operational continuity so the rest of the team can focus on students.

members.name: Ashley Wensch
members.title: Office Administrative Assistant
members.bio: Ashley is the Office Administrative Assistant at CSST, supporting the front office and the day-to-day work that keeps the school running for students and families.
